name: core-http-request-runtime-depth
salesforceExclusionReason: The fixture exercises the Glade-local HttpRequest.setBodyDocument(Object) overload, while Salesforce API 67 exposes setBodyDocument(Dom.Document); it receives zero Salesforce parity credit.

source.content: HttpRequest req = new HttpRequest(); System.assertEquals(true, req.equals(req)); System.assertNotEquals(null, req.hashCode()); req.setEndpoint('https://api.example.test/v4/items'); req.setMethod('patch'); req.setHeader('X-Trace', 'trace-42'); req.setCompressed(true); req.setTimeout(2500); req.setBody('payload-42'); System.assertEquals('https://api.example.test/v4/items', req.getEndpoint()); System.assertEquals('patch', req.getMethod()); System.assertEquals('trace-42', req.getHeader('X-Trace')); System.assertEquals(true, req.getCompressed()); System.assertEquals(2500, req.getTimeout()); System.assertEquals('payload-42', req.getBody()); req.setBodyAsBlob(Blob.valueOf('blob-42')); System.assertEquals('blob-42', req.getBodyAsBlob().toString()); Dom.Document doc = new Dom.Document(); doc.createRootElement('item', null, null); req.setBodyDocument(doc); System.assertEquals('item', req.getBodyDocument().getRootElement().getName()); Object docObject = doc; req.setBodyDocument(docObject); System.assertEquals('item', req.getBodyDocument().getRootElement().getName()); System.assertNotEquals(null, req.toString()); req.setTimeout(1800); System.assertEquals(1800, req.getTimeout());
